title: On the global feature importance for interpretable and trustworthy heat demand forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.13039v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The paper introduces the ante-hoc Explainable AI methodology to assess the global feature importance of the Machine Learning models used for heat demand forecasting in intelligent control of District Heating Systems, with motivation to facilitate their interpretability and trustworthiness, hence addressing the challenges related to adherence to communal standards, customer satisfaction and liability risks. Methodology includes use of four different approaches, namely intrinsic interpretability of Gradient Boosting method and selected post-hoc methods, namely Partial Dependence, Accumulated Local Effects and SHAP. None of the selected methods assume feature permutation or perturbations which can introduce bias due to introduction of random unrealistic values of data instances. Discussion of results is provided, including the assessment of complementarities where applicable, with specific interpretations in context of the district heating

translated_title: 面向可解释且可信的热需求预测的全局特征重要性研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：本文引入了事前可解释人工智能方法，用于评估在区域供热系统智能控制中用于热需求预测的机器学习模型的全局特征重要性，其动机是促进模型的可解释性和可信度，从而应对与遵守公共标准、客户满意度和责任风险相关的挑战。方法包括使用四种不同途径，即梯度提升方法的内在可解释性以及选定的事后方法，包括部分依赖图、累积局部效应和SHAP。所选方法均不假设特征置换或扰动，这些操作可能因引入随机不真实的数据实例值而导致偏差。文中提供了结果讨论，包括适用情况下的互补性评估，并结合区域供热的特定背景进行了具体解释。
tldr: 本文提出了一种事前可解释AI方法，结合多种无扰动事后技术，评估热需求预测模型的全局特征重要性，以提升区域供热系统的可解释性和可信度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an ante-hoc Explainable AI methodology, combining multiple perturbation-free post-hoc techniques, to assess global feature importance for heat demand forecasting models, enhancing interpretability and trustworthiness in district heating systems.
